steps: Remove grout around the damaged tile with a grout saw.
Carefully break and chisel out the cracked tile, protecting neighbors.
Scrape old mortar/adhesive from the subfloor flat.
Apply new thin-set mortar and press the replacement tile into place, using spacers.
Let cure, then apply matching grout and seal once fully dry.
